_meta.engine_compatibility: filter_engine.py v14.5.2 / config.py v14.5.1 / database.py v14.5.1 / monitors.py v14.5.2 / main.py v14.5.1
_meta.architecture: NLP Pipeline — Tokenization → Entity Extraction → Negation Analysis → Dependency Analysis → Distance Scoring → Ad Detection → Confidence Engine → Explainability → v10.0: + Clause Re-scoring + Similarity Gate + Deadline/Priority
design_principles: Template-driven generation AND a curated static high_confidence_boost_patterns list co-exist.
Every lexicon entry has ONE canonical form.
Ad detection: strong_provider = immediate reject, weak_provider requires 3+ commercial signals.
Negation is clause-based with explicit boundaries.
Token distance modifies score; message length modifies confidence.
English academic terms receive lower weight unless accompanied by Arabic intent verb.
Auto-learning disabled; human approval required for feedback integration.

CRITICAL: every keyword string used for trie matching MUST already be in normalized form (no أ/إ/آ/ة/ى/ئ/ؤ) — filter_engine.py normalizes INPUT text via _normalize_arabic() but keyword entries are used AS-IS.
CRITICAL: same AS-IS rule applies to English — every English keyword is lower-case only.
IMPORTANT: confidence_thresholds_design_target must stay in sync with config.py's CONFIDENCE_ACCEPT_THRESHOLD (0.65) / CONFIDENCE_REVIEW_THRESHOLD (0.40).
v16.1.0: FilterPolicy enforces MIN_MESSAGE_LENGTH=6, MAX_MESSAGE_LENGTH=65 (config.py defaults). Test cases reflecting shorter/longer inputs are explicitly tagged.
RESOLVED in v10.0 Precision: clause-level re-scoring in filter_engine.py (CLAUSE_RESCORE_ENABLED).
KNOWN LIMITATION: template_boost is a fixed +0.25 confidence add-on NOT gated on academic_object presence.
test_cases.*.text are deliberately raw (ة, hamzas) because they pass through the normalization pipeline during tests.

obfuscation_normalization._note: v16.1.0: remove_spaces_inside_words was previously claimed here but is NOT actually implemented by filter_engine v14.5.2's _clean(). Removed to avoid misleading documentation. If a future engine version adds space-collapse, restore this key and add the corresponding code.

fuzzy_matching._note: v15.2: scoped to a short high-value list with edit distance 1 and min token length 5.

confidence_thresholds_design_target._note: v15.2: aligned to ACTUAL runtime defaults (0.65/0.40).

fixes_changelog: == v16.1.0 (this pass) — comprehensive academic-vocabulary enrichment + 4 targeted fixes ==

1) [P1 bug] Trailing whitespace fixed: request_phrases.direct_requests entry 'تعرفون أحد يساوي تقرير ' had a trailing space that made it permanently dead weight — _normalize_term() does not strip keywords (only input text is stripped in _clean()). Changed to 'تعرفون احد يساوي تقرير'.

2) [P1 bug] resolution_phrases cleanup: removed 'تزوجت المشروع' (nonsensical — 'I married the project') plus social/marriage terms that do not belong in a filter's resolution detection: 'تم الزواج', 'زواجتي', 'تم الخطوبة', 'باص خط', 'محل عبايات', 'زبون'. These triggered a 1.0 negation score if they happened to appear near a genuine request, silently suppressing it. Marriage/social topics remain in ignore_signals.social_topics where they belong.

3) [P1 bug] Test-case length validation: 3 test cases violated FilterPolicy's MIN_MESSAGE_LENGTH=6 / MAX_MESSAGE_LENGTH=65 gates (which run BEFORE any scoring in filter_engine v14.5.2), so they could never reach the scoring engine despite being tagged 'accept'. Fixed: (a) 'محتاج' → 'محتاج مساعده' (13 chars, expected review); (b) 'تمام' → 'تمام شكرا' (10 chars, expected ignore); (c) the ~250-char long-message test shortened to 'طالبه هندسه، عندي مشروع تخرج يحتاج تحليل SPSS ومساعده' (53 chars); (d) the drive-link test shortened to 'رابط المشروع drive.google.com/f مساعدتكم' (36 chars). Each new test carries a '_covers' note explaining the FilterPolicy constraint.
4) [P2 doc] engine_compatibility now points to the actual v14.5.1/v14.5.2 stack instead of the outdated v13.2/v9.0/v10.0 references.
5) [Enrichment] Added 13 new academic_objects subsections covering real university disciplines that were previously absent or underrepresented:
- engineering_practicum: حساب احمال، مقاومه مواد، تحليل انشائي، ميكانيكا موائع، ديناميكا حراريه، تصميم ميكانيكي، الات كهربائيه.
- modern_ai_data: ذكاء اصطناعي، تعلم عميق، تعلم اله، machine learning، deep learning، data science، رؤيه حاسوب، معالجه لغه طبيعيه، شبكات عصبيه، tensorflow، pytorch، keras، sklearn.
- business_academic: دراسه جدوي، business plan، خطه عمل، تحليل سوقي، SWOT، business case، تقرير مالي، تحليل مالي، نقطه تعادل.

- cybersecurity_practicum: امن سيبراني، cybersecurity، اختراق اخلاقي، ethical hacking، تشفير، encryption، اختبار اختراق، penetration testing، جدار ناري، firewall، kali linux، metasploit.

- creative_production: مونتاج، montage، adobe premiere، final cut، davinci resolve، موشن جرافيك، motion graphics، انيميشن 2d، 2d animation، ادوبي انيميت، after effects، رسم رقمي، digital art، blender، maya، 3ds max، zbrush، procreate.
- presentation_design: بوستر اكاديمي، academic poster، انفوجرافيك، infographic، عرض تفاعلي، interactive presentation، نموذج ثلاثي الابعاد، 3d model، مجسم.
